book.name: Luka
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Luka gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Ŋgaŋ kune kwɛŋkfu bɛ muh wù sage bansa
Jiso mo wu ma ŋgaŋ wumu ki wu yɛ̂yɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo, lɛ bo kɛme ki bo bûunɛ segechii bo ya fwɛɛne gɛ.
Wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Muh wù sage bansa wumu gɛ̀ bee a kinlaantɛŋ kimi le, wu faane gɛ Nyo gɛ, wu yɛde gɛ jise chi muh le gɛ.
Kwɛŋkfu wumu gɛ̀ bee tɛ a kinlaantɛŋ kɛɛ le. Wu gɛ̀ gɛɛne segechii wu kude chiaaŋ muh wù sage bansa wɛɛ le lɛ wu fîh wu ki wu sûunɛ nsa we bɛ muh we wu kimbanɛ.
Muh wɛɛ leese gɛ gvune atunu gɛ, kwɛŋkfu wɛɛ mɛ gɛh wu gɛɛne fo. Ajiŋ ayu muh wɛɛ jɛmɛ kikwɛɛ ke le lɛ, ‘No nle fɛnɛ gɛ nfane Nyo gɛ, gɛ muh kooji fiɛɛ a mɛ jii gɛ,
geenɛ no kwɛŋkfu wunɛ too gɛh wu fuuŋse mɛ nɛ, nlé n'yɛ̂ŋ lɛ nlé nsûunɛ nsa we no wu goone, fuge noo sɛŋ, tu wu lé wu mɛ gɛh wu tôo wu jêese mɛ nɛ, muh lé wu jâ wu kwê lo a wu bo.’”

content: No Tada ma noo, wu mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ yu fiɛɛ fì muh wu gɛ̀ sage bansa ba kinfi, wunɛ gɛ jɛme.
No wu gɛ fi kwɛŋkfu wɛɛ nɛ, gɛ taŋlo Nyo fi tɛ bamii be ba wu le wu cha wa ba beede fɛ wu le antaŋ bɛ fɛnshɛ gɛ? Taŋlo wu tu wu chiide lo ye?
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ Nyo lé wu sûunɛ lo nsa wuboo chige. Geenɛ muh wù jee che le Mwamuh doo wu kaase wu too, wu lé wu yɛ̂ŋ bamii nyu yu ba leese muntele yi Nyo le fɛkuu fɛnɛ noo?”

content: Ŋgaŋ kune muh wu Bafalashii bɛ muh wù koode ŋwa
Jiso ja wu ka wu ma ŋgaŋ wumu, nyu bamii ba gɛ̀ yɛde ye yiboo le, lɛ bo le bamii ba chaaŋ, bo mo bo tu bo nyiɛŋse lo bamii bamu.

content.text: Wu jɛmɛ lɛ, “Bamii bamu bafɛɛ gɛ̀ bee bo bɛɛŋ bo gɛɛŋ yeh yi kintanyɛ le, ki bo buunɛ. Muh mu gɛ̀ bee muh Bafalashii, wumu nyu muh wù koode ŋwa.

Bo gɛɛŋ bo lee yeh yi kintanyɛ le, muh wu Bafalashii wɛɛ gɛɛŋ wu lɛɛŋ fie wu mo wu buunɛ lɛ, ‘Nyo, nnyaa wo kiyone njɛ gɛ mɛ nyume nje bamii bamu gɛ. Gɛ n'yɛɛde ajii yi mwɛɛ le gɛ. Gɛ nfige kinfi gɛ. Gɛ njaŋe bikɛɛ bamii lɛ gɛ, gɛ mɛ nyume tɛ njɛ muh wù koode ŋwa wege gɛ.
Nto mbane mwɛɛ munjile aju afaa yi kimaa le. Nto nnyaa kimbe kimimia wo le a ntɛnɛɛ a bimbe yuufe bi mwɛɛ munchii mu ŋkɛme.’
Geenɛ, muh wù gɛ̀ koode ŋwa wɛɛ gɛ̀ lɛɛŋ fie je yì ndefe le, wu gɛ bijɛ mo we gɛ, wu so kikwɛɛ, wu koo yii, wu mo wu buunɛ lɛ, ‘O Nyo, nle fiaŋ muh wù befe, kôo yii fɛ mɛne.’”

content: No Jiso ma nɛ, wu mo wu du lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ muh wù gɛ̀ koode ŋwa wɛɛ gɛ̀ bu wu bohge a wu yeh, wù nyu chaaŋ a Nyo jii fede muh wu Bafalashii wɛɛ. Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no muh wuchii wù bɛɛŋse ye ye, lé ba nyû ba gê ba shiishɛ lo wu, muh wuchii wù shiishi kikwɛɛ ke, ba lé ba gê ba bɛ̂ɛŋsɛ lo wu.”

content: Jiso koŋe booŋ ba shige shige
Bamii gɛ̀ ja bo too bɛ booŋ ba shige shige fɛ Jiso le lɛ wu kuŋ bo le. Booŋ be ba ŋgoo yɛŋ noo, bo tu bo leese lo bo.
Geenɛ, Jiso tɛɛŋ booŋ bayu lɛ bo tôo, wu mo wu jɛmɛ booŋ be ba ŋgoo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ chînɛ booŋ ba shige shige too fɛ mɛne. Keefɛ bɛŋ jêese bo gɛ, nje bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo, le nyu fɛ bamii ba le nje booŋ banɛ le.
Nsɛŋe bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, muh wù baaŋ fi gɛ bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo njɛ mwa wù shige gɛ, tu gɛ wu nyu wu ge wu lee fɛ bvunfoŋ bvuyu le gɛ.”

content: Jiso bɛ muh kwa
Muh wù baaŋ wumu biih Jiso le lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, wo wù muh wù joŋe, fiɛɛ fì ŋkɛme ki ŋge fɛ ŋkɛmɛ kinche kì kage gɛ, le la?”
Jiso biih wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo tɛŋe mɛ lɛ muh wù joŋe nje la? Gɛ muh nyu yu wù joŋe gɛ. Mɛ gɛh Nyo maa wù joŋe.
Geenɛ, ki ntu jiŋ yi fiɛɛ fì wo be bilɛ le, wo kee gɛ banchi ba duu lɛ,
‘Keefɛ wo jâŋ kwɛ muh gɛ,
keefɛ wo yûuyɛ muh gɛ,
keefɛ wo chôŋ bvuchoŋ gɛ,
keefɛ wo bɛ̂ɛ jiŋ yi nsa wu chimbiaŋ gɛ’,
bɛ lɛ,
‘Wo ŋgvûune chijo bɛ bwoo’ gɛ?”

content: Wu chvuu lɛ, “Banchi banɛ bachii ŋgɛ ŋkɛ wa ŋgɛɛde mbaaŋ chumu.”
Jiso yu noo, wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Tu fiɛɛ le fi shɛɛ fimimia fì wo baaŋ wo ge. Gɛnɛ, wo gesɛ mwɛɛ mwuŋ munchii, wo ga bige biyu bamii ba fuude le, wo mo wo kɛme nchvu nyu woŋ wù fɛwe. Wo doo wo ge noo, wo mo wo tô wo bîi mɛne.”

content: Geenɛ lɛ wu yu noo, ye mo yi wooŋ lo wu, nje wu gɛ̀ kɛme kwa baaŋ.
Jiso biji wu nɛ, wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Fi tɛɛme baaŋ fɛ muh wu kwa lee fɛ bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le.
Fi le chige fɛ nyambala le
ki yi lêe a jise chi nsala le fede fɛ muh wu kwa ki wu lêe yi bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo le.”

content: Bamii ba gɛ̀ bee fo yu noo, bo biih lɛ, “Finɛ le noo, yu to bonɛ yɛɛŋ?”
Geenɛ Jiso chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛ fiɛɛ fì ghage bamii ki bo ge taŋlo fi gha Nyo no wu ge gɛ.”

content: Bita jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Bîjɛ yɛ̂ŋ, bee le be chinɛ wa mwɛɛ mwesa le, bee tu be bii wo le.”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛɛŋ bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ, gɛ muh nyume yu wù le wu chinɛ la che le, kɛnɛ kwɛɛ le, kɛnɛ booŋ ba bwee le, kɛnɛ chiji le bɛ bwee le, kɛnɛ booŋ be le, nje bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo,
wu ge wu nyu wu nyume njɛ wu kɛmɛ bamii bɛ mwɛɛ wesee yi kiŋkfuuŋ kinɛ le yage mù wu chinɛ le gɛ. Lé tô nyûme yi kife ki kiŋkfuuŋ kì too le, wu kɛ̂me kinche kì kage gɛ.”

content: Jiso ka wu jɛmɛ kune kwe ye
Jiso ja wu jo booŋ be ba ŋgoo ba yuufe ncho bafɛɛ bɛ bo kɛŋsɛ yo. Wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, bee bɛɛne wa bee gɛɛne Yɛlusalɛm, sege bee bɛɛŋ be bu yo, fiɛɛ fichii fì bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo gɛ̀ saŋ kune muh wù jee che le Mwamuh lé fi tô fi kojɛ.
Fi mo fi tu fi nyu lɛ ba lé ba nyâ wu chiaaŋ yi bituŋ le, ba chwɛɛse wu, ba naanyi wu, ba chuuyi wu bɛ nchwene ye ye le.
Ba taane wu bɛ munte, ba yuuyɛ wu, ge doo nyume aju atade, wu bu yi kwe le.”

content: Jiso jɛmɛ noo, fi fuuŋsɛ bo, bo baaŋ kɛɛ gɛ laa wu jɛme lɛ la lɛ, nje fiɛɛ fimi gɛ̀ ge lɛ fɛ bo kɛɛ gɛ.
Jiso gwenyɛ ajii a kinfeeŋ
Jiso gɛ̀ doo wu fede a kinlaantɛŋ ki Jɛliku le, kinfeeŋ kimi shii jwe wu je le, ki lɛge mwɛɛ.
Wu yu no kinchvu ki bamii kfuunɛ ki fede, wu mo wu biih laa le la lɛ?
Bo chvuu wu le lɛ, le Jiso wu Nasalɛ wu fede.
Wu mo wu kɛ wu tu wu wanɛ lɛ, “Jiso, Mwa Nfoŋ Dabi, kôo yii fɛ mɛne.”
Bamii ba gɛ̀ saa fwe, waŋ wu bo jɛmɛ lɛ wu baŋ lo. Geenɛ wu ka wu mɛsɛ lo wu waŋ fɛwɛɛwe lɛ, “Mwa Nfoŋ Dabi, kôo yii fɛ mɛne.”
Jiso yu, wu lɛɛŋ wu jɛmɛ lɛ bo to bɛ wu. Bo to bɛ wu, Jiso biih wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo goone lɛ ŋge la fɛ wo le?”

content: Wu chvuu lɛ, “Tada, gêe lɛ ŋka yɛnɛ mwɛɛ le.”
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo yɛ̂ne la mwɛɛ le. Fitele fiuŋ fì wo lese yi ye yaŋ le, le fi ge wa ajii awo gwenyɛ.”

content: Kimimia noo, wu mo wu kaasɛ wu tu wu yɛde mwɛɛ le. Wu mo wu ja wu tu wu bii Jiso le wu tume maŋkuŋ ma Nyo. Bamii bachii ba gɛ̀ bee fo yɛŋ, bo nya mbɛɛŋsɛ Nyo le.

footnotes.text: Nyambala yinɛ le a jɛ yi bala le lɛ, “kamɛl.”
